intro.text: Natural geysers that are the main source of water for villages in Torio.

description.text: An eruption can throw water several dozen feet up, the height differing from place to place. Rural villages are usually built around their steamwell, and raised bronze trays set in concentric rings channel the falling water toward homes. Local people regard the water as a gift from the spirits below ground.
The wells moisten the air, feeding nearby plants, and clouds that gather over them give shade and rain. Each eruption is thought to freshen the air.
